independence.source: Frozen source.tar.gz only. The parent began subsequent working-tree fixes; no working-tree source was substituted.

method.basis: Complete README, full bodies of all 23 own core cpp files and their headers, production entry/config/build path and relevant native invocation boundary. Equation map was consulted after body review as a location inventory, never accepted as proof.

verdict.reason: Six unresolved concrete implementation/integration findings. No experimental or compilation claim is made.
verdict.math_assessment: The candidate has recognizable shared state, evidence and surface models: source identities, per-fragment evidence ownership, one posterior loss calculation and explicit candidate-domain surface voting. It is more than a name-level Update wrapper. However, the implementation is not yet unified end to end: final surface history uses a session-time proxy for state identity, the frame archive destructively disagrees with static fallback, and asynchronous/physical-evidence boundaries break the stipulated event fold. Therefore the complete candidate cannot currently be accepted as self-consistent.
verdict.performance_assessment: No current results were provided or generated. Quality, resource cost and fixed-protocol scores remain empirical obligations after all review issues are closed.

findings.title: 跨会话 pending 晋升后，旧 CURRENT 的 shown 几何仍获历史授权
findings.counterexample: A 结束时同一物理 ID 有 CURRENT c 和 separate 候选 q。q 的直接支持比 c 更新，但当时缺少足够可靠旧表面证据，未判定 replace；q 作为 observed_new 被保存。B 读入后实际观测否定 c，终结阶段以支持时间越过 succession_floor 的 q 晋升。q 的 birth 在 A，早于 B 的首帧。backend_session 只把本 session birth 的状态加入 state_starts，所以 q 不在其中；refusion 以 ID 存在且不在 state_starts 为依据，继续允许来自旧 c 的历史面片，未观察区域的 p=1 使其保留。
findings.impact: 已关闭旧位置可作为历史表面复活，写入 shown_state 并传播到 C。合法持久 pending 输入即可触发，无需异常数据。
findings.minimal_principled_fix: 把 shown 历史面的继续授权显式绑定到前序 CURRENT 的不可变 fragment/evidence identity。晋升另一 fragment 时撤销旧授权；观察时间下界继续独立保存，不以 birth 是否位于本 session 代替状态身份。

findings.title: FrameArchive 提前删除动态像素，后续合法静态回退失去全部原始证据
findings.counterexample: 正常物理对象的运动聚类像素被 dynamic_image 标记，但轨迹最大位移小于既定 min_dynamic_displacement（生产配置为 1 m）。preparePhysicalTrack 清除复制轨迹的动态标志，原生静态提取用保留帧的 object_image 成功提取并接受 CURRENT；其 object integrator 并不按 dynamic_image 删除这些像素。然而 FrameArchive::offer 已经不可逆地把对应量程置零。终结 refusion 的 PresentTSDF 无这些端点，在线补全候选 p=0，也无法得到 S 支持，最终清空相应对象面。
findings.impact: 同一正常输入的 tracker/static extractor 与终态表面证据互相矛盾；合法静态回退可在终结时消失。
findings.minimal_principled_fix: archive 保存原始有效量程、物理身份和必要分类信息；在最终状态授权时决定哪些端点进入当前表面，包含被接受的静态回退。保留原生在线动态屏蔽行为，不能在 archive 入库时销毁以后仍可能获授权的测量。

findings.title: 继承种子验收遗漏内容指纹，只核对序列化长度与对象数
findings.counterexample: output.initial 的某个顶点位置、颜色、支持时间或 details 数值被错误改变，但序列化字段数量和字节长度不变，物理 ID 数量亦不变。canonical_fields 只比较 schema、bytes、objects，结构字段也只比较数量/ID，因此仍通过。inspector 已输出 canonical_current_scene_fingerprint_fnv1a64，但 gate 没有使用它。
findings.impact: README:660 所承诺的 output.initial 与 input 推理 current 一致性没有实际检验；正常等尺寸内容回归被放行。
findings.minimal_principled_fix: 比较完整 canonical 内容摘要，保留明确允许的规范化。如果实际重映射使摘要不等，应修正规范化定义或实际种子恢复，不应省略摘要比较。

findings.title: 有序提取完成队列没有固定提取结果所属的传感器事件
findings.counterexample: 正常多对象提取任务的 generation g 在 active-window 输出 t_j 前一瞬完成或后一瞬完成。默认 detach_object_extraction=true，生产 YAML 没有关闭；threaded 路径不 join，fillOutput 只取当时已完成的连续前缀。因此同一 g 可进入 t_j，也可进入后续输出。后端等待只能固定已收到包的判定完成，无法补回尚未注入该包的对象几何。
findings.impact: 线程耗时改变 t_j 的 G、对象状态和判定序列；顺序稳定不等于事件归属稳定，违反 README:131-139 的 (4b)。
findings.minimal_principled_fix: 在项目生产路径为每个输出确定已接受 generation watermark，并在发布该输出前 drain 到该水位；同步提取或等价有序 fence 均可，保留原生提取数学算法。

findings.title: native D2 的物理证据适配读取超出当前 decision stamp 的帧
findings.counterexample: active-window ACK 后继续正常处理后续帧，physical store 已含 t+delta 的帧；backend 正对 stamp=t 的 clone 运行检测。SequentialChangeDetector 接收 t，却未把它传入物理 snapshot 的边界；RayObjectChangeDetector 冻结整个共享 store，after 查询 latest=max。对象在 t 后被遮挡/移走的实测帧可参与 t 的 D2 reduction。调度稍慢/稍快会读到不同帧集。
findings.impact: 未来观测进入过去 decision 的 D2 presence/changes，破坏因果性和同输入确定性。own CURRENT verifier 使用 stamp 上界并不能修复 native 适配处的无限上界。
findings.minimal_principled_fix: 在项目物理证据薄接口上携带当前 decision stamp，冻结或裁剪可见帧域到该 stamp；保持 Khronos 原生 D1/D2 reducer 和参数不变。

findings.title: 生产 --require-built 检查不核验已写入的源码指纹
findings.counterexample: 一次正确 canonical 构建后，正常修改 session_core 源码但忘记重建，再运行 run_session。源码目录、CMakeCache 路径及动态库来源路径都未变，--require-built 仍返回 CANONICAL_RUNTIME_OK；两个 fingerprint 标记从未读取，也没有别处对当前源码做比较。
findings.impact: 实际运行旧 binary，但实验可能被记录为当前源码结果；不能满足 contract 的精确候选源码/在线结果绑定。
findings.minimal_principled_fix: 在 --require-built 用构建脚本相同的选集重算指纹并与安装/运行层标记比较，不同即拒绝；运行记录保存实际核验的摘要。

working_model_assumptions_accepted: Stable nonzero physical IDs and finite, protocol-compliant RGB-D/pose input are the stated working domain.
Reliable-surface sample abstraction, fixed quantization, native mobility threshold and fixed posterior loss ratio are explicit model/protocol choices; no demand was made to tune them.
The independent-ray and single-layer surface working assumptions are explicit. Their scene fitness and quality remain the fixed offline protocol's responsibility.
Khronos native D1/D2 mathematical algorithms are reused. Findings A-04/A-05 concern scheduling/evidence interfaces, not rederivation or replacement of native reducers.
Equation (2) is a quality objective, not a proof that CURRENT geometry always beats pure-B.
actual_call_chain: scripts/run_session.sh validates input catalog and predecessor bundle, invokes canonical runtime preflight, strict runner and state inspector, then publishes a new output directory.
scripts/run_khronos_session_strict.sh sets SessionBackend/ROS input config; nss_flat_ros2_player.py publishes packed labels, RGB-D and poses with frame ACKs.

app/session_khronos_node.cpp starts ExperimentManager/KhronosPipeline; ActiveWindow preprocesses, motion/object/tracker updates, offers FrameArchive, runs native mapping, ingests PhysicalEvidenceStore on outputs and submits native extraction.
ObjectWorkerPool reserves generation, extraction_source attaches UUID/generation, OrderedExtractionCompletion returns completed prefix into frontend/backend packets.

SessionBackend::loadInputState verifies bundle, restores chain reasoning geometry, shown memory, registry, evidence mosaic, background obligations and sensor/depth statistics; seed projection gives one initial snapshot.

Backend processes fixed-count decision requests; SequentialChangeDetector sees per-segment objects before sessionBeforeReconcile ingests sources and verifies CURRENT with frozen own evidence. Reconciler runs; sessionAfterReconcile canonicalizes physical objects from persistent state; map snapshots are stored.

Pipeline terminal stop drains input/active-window/frontend/backend, finishes pending inference, resolves pending state, then Backend::updateFinalMap -> SessionRefusion::apply builds PresentTSDF, authorizes/history/fill candidates, computes actual pixel support/free/replace evidence and materializes retained geometry.
saveSessionState writes reasoning chain, shown map, registry, evidence, scales and surface error; SessionBundle fsync/hash manifest publishes a complete checkpoint. C invokes the same load path as B.

sessionSceneAt selects last published stamp <= query and clones it; 4dmap_mesh_server/export/inspector use this shared reader. This read policy does not repair earlier causality defects in the stored snapshots.
equation_review: Load/fold/drain/surface/save are real connected stages; A-02/A-04/A-05/A-06 break end-to-end contract.
No current performance claim or redefinition of score; fixed baseline comparison still required.
Distinct current/session/pending/history/source/evidence clocks are represented; history surface authorization loses fragment identity (A-01).
World-space union, bbox re-expression, minimum start and maximum true support are implemented; death bounded by actual support.
UUID/generation source identity validated and persisted; dedup per physical ID; materialized current excluded from raw source collection.
Backend decision wait is present, but extraction publication and native physical-store time domain remain scheduler-dependent (A-04/A-05).
Replacement/refinement/separation use joint evidence and geometry relation; local-state transitions distinct from terminal session settlement.
Sample-domain threshold, surface agreement, mobility eligibility and temporal successor gates are explicit; not inferred from node ID.
History/pending conservation exists; reusing old shown geometry after different pending successor promotes is defective (A-01).
Absorption checks real support in candidate bounds; pending selection uses newest support above succession floor.
Only newer accepted dynamic trajectory metadata is consumed to close current, with persisted motion watermark.
Native interval reduction owns newest direct endpoint, caps predecessor and merges admissible gaps.
Actual pixel projection and radial residual exist; D2 interface needs explicit temporal clipping (A-05).
Identity/range encoding and immutable timestamp checks are implemented; archive destructively filters later authorized fallback measurements (A-02).
Bidirectional projection grouped by actual target pixel; all-source contradiction, retaining unknown completion, minimum domain and latest incompatible cut select suffix.
Native displacement fallback is implemented as specified; archive eligibility contradicts it (A-02).
World surface samples, reliability hits, latest mosaic grouped by frame/pixel, and retaining completion implement the stated finite-evidence abstraction.
Equal-state posterior moments, finite concentration and frozen prior batch avoid within-batch order dependence.
Normalized truncated beta retaining model and absent uniform domain evaluated in log space, with bounded numerical branches.
Posterior odds compared with stated loss ratio; no experiment-derived threshold adjustment proposed.
Own absence observation processes only eligible new frames and preserves support/reliability state across checkpoints.
Evidence key, geometry revision and through bounds checked before authority is granted to a state's surface evidence.
Current-time pixel domain and closed-state exclusion implemented downstream, but premature archive loss (A-02) and history-identity proxy (A-01) violate authorization.
Stale-ray lambda bound and asymmetric legal integration interval passed to PresentTSDF.
Unweighted signed-distance averaging and all-eight-corner integrated MC domain inspected.
Present face slot assigned from actual supported endpoint votes with deterministic timestamp/ID tie order, and per-face support timing.
Fixed raw correspondence set, bounded two-stage scale search, minimum sample count and upper-median objective match documented procedure.
Fixed residual histogram/MAD scale, sufficient count and nearest original populated-bin fill checked.
History prior and fill candidates are distinct, but history eligibility uses session birth proxy rather than predecessor state (A-01); fill cannot compensate for deleted evidence (A-02).
Noise/range/previous-error ball radius is positive and constructed from candidate support.
Global first triangle hit, physical identity, normal side and measured range consistency checked; single-layer limitation accepted as model assumption.
S endpoint support, F full footprint, R nearer compatible first surface and unknown/occlusion branches inspected; actual pixel evidence, not bounding box overlap.
Analytic ray/sphere interval and projected sphere bounds include off-image unknown witness; all relevant discrete rays evaluated.
Occlusion/unknown contribute no directional decision; S opposes F/R under symmetric decision cost.
Strict p+S>F+R retention implemented; consequences depend on authorized evidence/candidates, hence A-01/A-02 upstream matter.
Exact oriented cyclic geometry and slot key, present/history/fill ordering avoids approximate spatial deletion.
Output exact-triangle sources chosen deterministically; attribute freshness and first-positive timestamp reductions inspected.
Bundle roundtrip contains real current/pending geometry, immutable IDs and sufficient evidence; acceptance gate content comparison missing (A-03), inherited shown authorization inconsistent (A-01).
Closed-background obligations carry world point, original mesh timestamp and last support; rebind and absence verification use saved obligation identity.
Mosaic, reliable support and calibration stats persist; live keys retained and next batch reference frozen.
Reader uses last<=t and cloned scene, but cannot undo future evidence or delayed extraction already assigned to wrong producer snapshot (A-04/A-05).

coverage_notes.core: All 23 own cpp bodies were read, including anonymous helpers and all branches; all own headers were read, including inline algorithms. The attached function index is location metadata from the provided mapping after independent body inspection, not an endorsement of its role annotations.
coverage_notes.static_build_assessment: Own core object targets, include paths, OpenSSL/zstd dependencies, canonical install and runtime target linkage were read. No definite additional compile-signature defect established by this review. Actual compilation remains unperformed and forbidden until all review findings close.
coverage_notes.scope_assessment: Source inspected stays within candidate own core and required native/runtime interfaces. No protected/external path was mutated. This report does not assert a bytewise unchanged-native proof against the starting Git commit.
coverage_notes.limitations: This is a static review, not formal verification. It establishes concrete counterexamples and local consistency evidence, not actual runtime scores or build success.
